text: Root cause located 2026-10-09 (main 9431e120): the canonical study-result codec writes each estimated density mass inline as a JSON number array (codec ResultCodecs.describeScale: "values" -> Json.arr(mass.values.toVector.map(Json.fromDoubleOrNull)*); same in DensityWire.inline). Writing streams items (CanonicalDoc), but reading goes through ArtifactResolver.document -> io.circe.parser.parse(text) of the whole result document, so all 11.5M cells exist at once as io.circe.JsonDouble/JNumber (~0.45 GB) plus the decoded Vector-based structures and repeated key strings (~1.4 GB Object[] + ~0.75 GB String/byte[] at peak). Fix options (library codec, needs a decision and a schema version step with pinned fixtures and a migration): (a) store masses as binary payload entries (the manifest already supports layout/payload entries: Decoded.Payload) and reference them from the result document by digest; (b) a streaming decoder for the result document that never builds the full circe tree; (c) both. Option (a) also shrinks the 153 MB archive. Likely a wave-4 library slice that wave 1 depends on for user-scale projects; split before implementation.
